question: The partition of Bengal officially came into force in the year _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1905**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Partition of Bengal** was announced on **20 July 1905** by the then Viceroy of India, **Lord Curzon**, and it officially came into effect on **16 October 1905**.
 
• The partition divided Bengal into two provinces: **Eastern Bengal and Assam** (with Dhaka as its capital) and **West Bengal** (with Calcutta as its capital).
 
• The primary justification provided for the partition was the **administrative convenience**, as Bengal was one of the largest provinces in British India, both in terms of area and population.
 
• The decision was met with widespread protests, as it was seen by many Indians as an attempt to **divide Hindus and Muslims** and weaken the growing nationalist movement.
